drhp.business: The Company owns and develops real estate at a single campus in Solapur, Maharashtra, leasing retail, food, entertainment and office space to national and international brands and earning rental income from them. It also runs a hospitality business comprising Shubham Resort and Banquets and quick-service food formats on the campus, and hosts managed office centres for technology-enabled services clients. Reporting is on two segments, Property and Related Services and Hospitality Services, with the Company progressively shifting food and beverage from self-operation to third-party operators …

risks.note: MD&A Risks and Concerns states operations are concentrated in a single city and, substantially, on a single campus, exposing the Company to local economic conditions and the pace of development at Solapur. There is no geographic or asset diversification to absorb a downturn in that one market.

Performance is tied to a small set of anchors - Star Bazaar, Westside, Zudio and Mr. DIY - plus recently commenced brands. MD&A explicitly flags exposure to 'the performance of a limited number of anchor lessees/licensees', so the loss or underperformance of one anchor would materially affect footfall and rental income.
risks.risk: Dependence on a limited number of anchor lessees/licensees

risks.note: The Joint Managing Director discloses that finance costs of Rs. 290.36 lakhs equalled roughly 41 per cent of revenue from operations, that interest cover remained below one time through the year, and that net worth is negative as a result of accumulated losses. The Company has borrowed to fund development and is seeking shareholder approval to increase borrowing limits, so debt servicing depends on leasing income arriving on schedule.
risks.risk: Leverage and negative net worth - interest cover below one time

risks.note: Management states the asset base is 'substantially constructed but not yet fully income-generating', with the FY26 loss arising only after depreciation of Rs. 94.20 lakhs on recently capitalised campus assets and finance costs on development borrowings. If committed lessees do not take possession and begin trading as expected, the gap between EBITDA and fixed charges does not close.
risks.risk: Asset base constructed ahead of the income it will produce

risks.note: Rentals from US Polo Assn., Arrow, Blackberrys, Jockey and Fastrack had not commenced at the year end and are only expected during FY 2026-27, and Connplex Cinemas remained work in progress. The expected improvement in revenue depends on these commencing on time.
risks.risk: Execution and timing risk on committed leasing and the Connplex Cinemas fit-out

risks.note: Both the MD&A Threats section and Risks and Concerns flag competition from other developers and retail destinations and changes in consumer preferences. Retail destinations are moving to experience-led formats, so the campus must keep reinvesting in tenant mix and experience to hold footfall.
risks.risk: Competition from other developers and retail destinations, and shifting consumer preferences

risks.note: MD&A lists interest rate movements, changes in government policy and regulatory approvals affecting the timing of development as market-related risks. Given the Company's leverage, rate movements feed directly into finance costs, and approval delays push out the income from the master-planned site.
risks.risk: Interest rate movements, government policy and regulatory approvals affecting development timing

risks.note: The MD&A states the pace of growth may be influenced by changes in IT employment trends, brand expansion plans, availability of skilled manpower and evolving market demand, and the Chairman describes connectivity as the single largest external opportunity. These are drivers outside the Company's control on which its co-working, office and retail plans rest.
risks.risk: Dependence on Solapur's demand drivers - IT employment, brand expansion plans and connectivity
